about: Public figures whose likeness or name is documented in a primary public source as abused in Polish scam ads or lures (PL-SCAM stream, 2026-11-21). Names only, as public knowledge; listing never implies that the person took part in a scam. Stems are folded (hydra.genome.txt_norm.fold); a surname token matches when it starts with a stem and adds at most 3 characters (Polish inflection).

persons.abuse: fake investment pages using his likeness (300 new pages in one week of March 2024)

sources.where: p. 38, 'Oszustwa reklamowe na dużych platformach internetowych'
